display-sm.purpose: Section headings, sheet and dialog titles.

body-sm.purpose: Meta lines, dates, distances, hints and errors.

caption-sm.purpose: Small meta text, tags, the sample note.

button-sm.purpose: Small buttons, tertiary buttons, segment tabs.

nav-link.purpose: Top-bar tab names (set to 15px in TabBar).

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: The only shadow token: map pins and overlays, the switch knob, the slider thumb, a dragged item, a link card on hover.

shadows.name: tabbar-pill (not a token)
shadows.purpose: Written in TabBar in front of shadow-float, on the phone pill.

motion.name: motion-medium
motion.purpose: Sheets, dialogs and photos sliding into place.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: A small overshoot: buttons letting go, chips popping on.

weather.name: Layered drops

tokens.name: rain-wash
tokens.purpose: The tint over a rainy area: 40% in the middle, 28% at half way, 10% near the edge, nothing at it. Feathered, never a hard circle.

tokens.name: rain-streak
tokens.purpose: The drops, 0.38, 0.6 and 0.85 opacity for the far, middle and near layer.

tokens.name: rain-text
tokens.purpose: Chip text and icon on white: 9.5:1.

weather.darkMode: None: the app has no dark theme, so each token has one value.
weather.composition: A feathered radial wash and the three layers of drops clipped by a feathered mask that ends at 66/72 of the wash radius. Patterns, not nodes: three rectangles for each patch. Under the routes, pins and markers; no pointer events; tiles and attribution untouched.

words.when: unavailable, outside the window or not known
words.text: No chip, and no rain drawn

motion.rain-in: 900ms ease-out, opacity only, once when the rain first appears
motion.rain-fall: linear and endless, transform only; one tile of the pattern each loop
motion.rain-chip-in: 600ms ease-out after 200ms, opacity and a 4px rise
motion.reducedMotion: No falling and no fade: the wash and the drops are drawn still, so the meaning is not lost.

screens.textEquivalent: The status line under the greeting; the map and chip are aria-hidden.
screens.chip: Just under the first rainy place, at the map's scale; moved below the wash because pins fan out above a meeting point.

screens.textEquivalent: The chip is inside the map region and is read with it.
screens.chip: Top middle, 64 px down, clearing the zoom buttons and View map / Expand map; under the bar on the full-screen map, which also shows WeatherSource.

weather.homeLine: homeRainText follows the same rule (rainWindow): "in the next two hours" only for the live two-hour forecast; no time clause for another live forecast; "Simulated rain around X" for the demo.
weather.currency: Rain and the chip are drawn only while the forecast is current: before validUntil, or before issue time + 2 h when there is no end; simulated forecasts always count; a live forecast with no times does not.

cost.measured: Chromium, CPU x4, 1/3/6 patches, Home and a panned Leaflet map: every frame 16.7 ms, no frame over 25 ms; raster about 85 ms per patch per 4 s.

weather.zoom: On PlannerMap each rainy stop has its own patch, about 1 km each way, 170 to 480 px across; it scales with the zoom glide (250 ms) and is made again at the new size when the zoom ends.

narrative.overview:
Jio is a white page with near-black text and one bright red, called Rausch in the code (`--primary`). The red marks the place where people meet and the action that gets them there: the map pin on Home, the "Create" circle in the navigation, the main button on a screen, the filled steps of a session. Home opens on a muted dotted map of Singapore (`SingaporeMap`) with routes drawing in from around the island to one point, and a red pin (`PinButton`) standing on that point with the Jio logo in its head.

Around that centre the product is plain. Cards are white with a 1px grey line and no shadow until they are hovered. Type is Inter at modest weights (400 to 700). Controls are round: pills, circles and 8px corners. Navigation is a white pill floating at the bottom of a phone and a full-width bar along the top from 744px. Three screens (Leaderboard, Rewards, Profile) sit on a fine grid whose cells shade softly in grey where the pointer passes (`GridPulse`). The app's currency is drawn as a pink coin with a crown (`CoinBadge`), and the same crown replaces the dot of the "i" in the logo (`JioLogo`).

Photos come in two kinds. Place photos are one stock picture per kind of place, captioned "Illustrative photo" on the place's detail view. Session photos hang as instant prints on a string (`PolaroidLine`) and open in a dark full-screen viewer (`PhotoViewer`). The copy is short labels and statuses, with no exclamation marks, no emoji and no upper-case labels; estimated times always say "about".
keyCharacteristics: One red (`--primary`, `#ff385c`) on a white canvas with `#222222` ink.
A dotted map of Singapore and a red map pin as the Home screen's signature.
Pill navigation on phones, a top bar from 744px.
Flat white cards with a hairline; a shadow only for things that float or are hovered.
Information colours for categories, people and travel time, always with a word, icon or key.
Motion on almost everything, all of it switched off or shortened under reduced motion.
Sample content and estimates are said to be so in words.

rules.name: The Information Colour Rule
rules.body: Category, person, travel and medal colours say what something is and never mark an action. Each appears with a word, an icon or a key: `CategoryKey` on maps, the category's name on `CategoryIcon`, "about 25 min" beside a coloured travel time, the rank number beside a medal.

rules.name: The Two Selections Rule
rules.body: As shipped, a choice the user toggles is filled with ink (`ChipButton`, `ToggleSwitch`, `SegmentTabs`, `RangeSlider`, `TravelConnector`, `ProgressBar`), and progress or position is filled with red (`SessionSteps`, `SegmentedProgress`, `ProgressDonut`, the current tab in `TabBar`). `CalendarPicker` is the exception: its selected day is red. See Known Conflicts.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Times, counts and amounts take `.tnum` so digits line up (`CoinBadge`, `CountdownChip`, `SegmentedProgress`, the Leaderboard countdown).

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: A card has a hairline and no shadow. It lifts by 2px with `--shadow-float` on hover only when the whole card is a link (`SessionCard`, `PlaceCard`). A card that cannot be clicked does not lift.

rules.name: The Rain Look Rule
rules.body: Rain on a map is the blue wash and three layers of drops of `--rain-wash` and `--rain-streak`, under everything else on the map, with a white `RainChip` that says where the forecast came from. It is information, never an action, and the chip says "next 2 h" only for the live two-hour forecast. Under reduced motion it stands still.

dos: Do take every colour, size, radius and shadow from `frontend/src/styles/tokens.css`, and every type size from the `--text-*` tokens or their classes.
Do keep one main action per screen and give it `AppButton` (`primary`, or `primary next` when it moves to the next step).
Do fill a toggled choice with `--selected` (ink) and a measure of progress with `--primary`.
Do show category, person, travel and medal colours with a word, an icon or a key beside them.
Do keep cards flat with a 1px `--hairline`, and add the hover lift only when the whole card is a link.
Do make every tap target at least `--tap-min` (44px), as `ChipButton` and `ToggleSwitch` do by padding a smaller shape.
Do write estimated times as "about N min" and mark hand-written content with `SampleNote`.
Do give every animation a reduced-motion path, and check `prefers-reduced-motion` in script when the script itself animates.
Do read Known Conflicts before placing new white text on `--primary`, on a category colour or on a person colour. Those pairs are open decisions.
donts: Don't use a category, person, travel or medal colour for a button or a link.
Don't render a second `TabBar`, a second `PinButton`, or `GridPulse` inside a card.
Don't put a backdrop behind `PopoverPanel`, or use it for a task that needs a footer of several buttons; use `BottomSheet`.
Don't show a price as a number where `PriceTier` is used, or the word "JioCoins" where `CoinBadge` fits.
Don't write a label in upper case, add an exclamation mark, or use emoji. No screen does.
Don't load Bootstrap. It is a dependency in `frontend/package.json` and is not imported in `frontend/src/main.js`.
